sources.title: [26.18] First we fight, then we eat! - A comprehensive Braum guide.

passive.name: Concussive Blows
passive.text: Braum's basic attacks apply Concussive Blows. Once the first stack is applied, ally basic attacks also stack Concussive Blows. Upon reaching 4 stacks, the target is stunned and takes magic damage. For the next few seconds they cannot receive new stacks, but take bonus magic damage from Braum's attacks.

spells.name: Winter's Bite
spells.text: Braum propels freezing ice from his shield, slowing and dealing magic damage.Applies a stack of Concussive Blows.

spells.name: Stand Behind Me
spells.text: Braum leaps to a target allied champion or minion. On arrival, Braum and the ally gain Armor and Magic Resist for a few seconds.

spells.name: Unbreakable
spells.text: Braum raises his shield in a direction for several seconds, intercepting all projectiles causing them to hit him and be destroyed. He negates the damage of the first attack completely and reduces the damage of all subsequent attacks from this direction.

spells.name: Glacial Fissure
spells.text: Braum slams the ground, knocking up enemies nearby and in a line in front of him. A fissure is left along the line that slows enemies.

damage.value: Braum deals burst magic damage when Concussive Blows reaches four stacks, and Winter’s Bite also deals magic damage.

archetype.value: Braum is a support who specializes in disengaging and peeling but can also play offensively.

axis.value: Braum can poke with Winter’s Bite, which slows targets and applies a Concussive Blows stack from up to 1000 range.

winCondition.value: Braum helps win fights by protecting his team with disengage and peel.

spikes.why: Braum is especially strong during early invades.
Braum can use Unbreakable more often when its cooldown falls from 16 to 8 seconds.

bait.why: After Braum spends Unbreakable, its cooldown leaves him without its projectile interception and directional damage reduction.

mistakes.value: Braum players can struggle when they try to engage on their own.
Braum loses Unbreakable’s directional protection when he faces his shield away from incoming attacks.
